summary_en: 900,000 shares (1.80% S/O) to be acquired for ¥3,190.5M via ToSTNeT-3 on 13 Jul 2026 at ¥3,545/share. All acquired shares to be cancelled on 31 Jul 2026. Aim: enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3) and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 10 July 2026, TKC's board resolved to acquire up to 900,000 treasury shares (1.80% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate of ¥3,190.5M and to cancel all acquired shares. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading on 13 July 2026 at or below ¥3,545/share, which was the closing price (including final special quotation) on the announcement date. The buy order is limited to the trading session on that date only. Results will be announced after the trading session closes. Cancellation of all acquired shares is scheduled for 31 July 2026. The company stated the buyback and cancellation aim to enhance capital efficiency and enrich shareholder returns, taking into account its financial position and market conditions.
